Mar 10, 2025

Winter Fest 2025 Recap

A fantastic weekend of competitive matches across all age groups at Central Park in Santa Clarita.

By Playmaker Sports

Winter Fest brought teams to Central Park in Santa Clarita for a full weekend of competitive youth soccer. Matches across the age groups gave players the chance to compete, develop, and finish the winter season in a tournament setting.

From the opening games through the championship rounds, clubs produced exciting finishes and strong performances. Families filled the sidelines and helped create the energetic, community-focused atmosphere that Playmaker Sports works to bring to every event.

Thank you to the coaches, referees, volunteers, partners, players, and supporters who made Winter Fest 2025 possible. Their work on and off the field kept the weekend running and made it a success for the participating teams.

We look forward to welcoming the soccer community back for future Playmaker Sports tournaments and building on the Winter Fest experience.
